description: Seller-declared cancellation terms for a product. Declares the minimum notice period required before cancellation takes effect and the cancellation fee for insufficient notice. Buyers accept these terms by creating a media buy against the product.

allOf.$comment: rate quantifies a percent_remaining fee; without it the cancellation cost is undefined.
amount quantifies a fixed_fee; without it the cancellation cost is undefined.

cancellation_fee.description: Fee applied when the notice period is not met.

amount.description: Fixed fee amount in the buy's currency. Required when type is 'fixed_fee'.

rate.description: Fee rate as a decimal proportion of remaining committed spend. Required when type is 'percent_remaining' (e.g., 0.5 means 50% of remaining spend).

type.description: Fee calculation method. 'percent_remaining': percentage of remaining uncommitted spend. 'full_commitment': buyer owes the full committed budget regardless of delivery. 'fixed_fee': flat monetary amount. 'none': no financial fee (cancellation with notice is free).

notice_period.description: Minimum notice period before cancellation takes effect (e.g., { interval: 30, unit: 'days' }). A guaranteed buy canceled without sufficient notice incurs the declared cancellation fee.

interval.description: Number of time units. Must be 1 when unit is 'campaign'.

unit.description: Time unit. 'seconds' for sub-minute precision. 'campaign' spans the full campaign flight.

notice_period.title: Duration

title: Cancellation Policy
